name: peer-sessions
description: Parallel Claude Code sessions on one machine see each other, message and wait for each other, remember what earlier sessions did in a repository, and claim files, branches and ports. Holds back once before an edit or git command that would race a live peer.

mode.title: On a collision
mode.description: refuse: hold the edit or git command back once and tell the model why. warn: let it run and tell the model afterwards.

shareTask.title: Share my task line
shareTask.description: Show other sessions the first line of what you asked this one to do. Off: they see that a session is live, its folder and files, not its task.
